public_events.text: I’m using the AutoCAD image-modeling skill for this reconstruction. I’ll independently interpret the drawing, build the solid through isolated Core Console jobs, then inspect the resulting DWG and revise it if the geometry checks expose discrepancies.

The part’s overall form is clear: a 64 mm long base with four mounting ears, two longitudinal guide rails, and several drilled/threaded features. I’m resolving the crowded end and section dimensions now so the first solid encodes the nominal profile instead of relying on the isometric view alone.

public_events.text: The section resolves into a stepped rail profile: a 23 mm central body, a 3 mm top channel, an 11.5 mm underside channel, and a connecting mid-web. I’m building that profile with the 43 × 64 × 22.1 mm envelope, the two mounting-ear bands, the 6 × 11 through window, and all visible drilling directions; the mid-length rail break will retain the drawing’s 1 mm supporting lip.

arguments.lisp:
(setvar "CMDECHO" 0)
(setvar "FILEDIA" 0)
(setvar "INSUNITS" 4)
(command "_.UCS" "_W")
(command "_.ERASE" "_ALL" "")
(setq parts nil cuts nil)
(defun addbox (x1 y1 z1 x2 y2 z2 / e)
  (command "_.BOX" (list x1 y1 z1) (list x2 y2 z1) (- z2 z1))
  (setq e (entlast))
  (setq parts (cons e parts))
  e)
(defun addcutbox (x1 y1 z1 x2 y2 z2 / e)
  (command "_.BOX" (list x1 y1 z1) (list x2 y2 z1) (- z2 z1))
  (setq e (entlast))
  (setq cuts (cons e cuts))
  e)
(defun addcutcyl (p1 p2 r / e)
  (command "_.CYLINDER" p1 r "_A" p2)
  (setq e (entlast))
  (setq cuts (cons e cuts))
  e)
(defun mkss (lst / s)
  (setq s (ssadd))
  (foreach e lst (if (entget e) (ssadd e s)))
  s)
;; Main 23 mm stepped longitudinal section about datum B.
(addbox -10.75 0.0 6.0 12.25 64.0 15.1)
(addbox -10.75 0.0 14.1 -1.5 64.0 22.1)
(addbox 1.5 0.0 14.1 12.25 64.0 22.1)
(addbox -10.75 0.0 0.0 -5.75 64.0 6.1)
(addbox 5.75 0.0 0.0 12.25 64.0 6.1)
;; Four outboard mounting ears, 7 thick and 1 below the rail crest.
(addbox -20.75 0.0 14.1 -10.65 10.0 21.1)
(addbox 12.15 0.0 14.1 22.25 10.0 21.1)
(addbox -20.75 45.0 14.1 -10.65 55.0 21.1)
(addbox 12.15 45.0 14.1 22.25 55.0 21.1)
(command "_.UNION" (mkss parts) "")
(setq solids (ssget "_X" '((0 . "3DSOLID"))))
(setq body (ssname solids 0))
;; 6 x 11 full-depth central window.
(addcutbox -3.0 35.0 -0.5 3.0 46.0 22.6)
;; Five-mm interruption in the right upper rail, leaving the 1 mm support lip.
(addcutbox 1.49 30.0 15.1 12.30 35.0 22.6)
;; Four mounting bores dia 5.50 through Z.
(foreach x '(-15.75 17.25)
  (foreach y '(5.0 50.0)
    (addcutcyl (list x y 13.5) (list x y 22.6) 2.75)))
;; Four vertical blind M3 drill bores dia 2.50, depth 8.
(foreach x '(-8.5 9.0)
  (foreach y '(5.0 55.0)
    (addcutcyl (list x y 22.6) (list x y 14.1) 1.25)))
;; Four longitudinal M3 drill bores, two from each end.
(foreach x '(-7.25 8.75)
  (progn
    (addcutcyl (list x -0.1 9.0) (list x 8.05 9.0) 1.25)
    (addcutcyl (list x 64.1 16.5) (list x 55.95 16.5) 1.25)))
;; Two aligned H7 openings through the opposed upper rails, dia 3 at Y=29.
(addcutcyl (list -10.90 29.0 17.0) (list 12.40 29.0 17.0) 1.5)
;; Opposed M4 pilot bores dia 3.30, nominal 9.25 deep at Y=25.
(addcutcyl (list -10.90 25.0 17.0) (list -1.40 25.0 17.0) 1.65)
(addcutcyl (list 12.40 25.0 17.0) (list 2.90 25.0 17.0) 1.65)
(command "_.SUBTRACT" body "" (mkss cuts) "")
(setq finalss (ssget "_X" '((0 . "3DSOLID"))))
(princ (strcat "\nFINAL_3DSOLID_COUNT=" (itoa (if finalss (sslength finalss) 0))))
(if finalss
  (progn
    (setq final (ssname finalss 0))
    (princ (strcat "\nFINAL_HANDLE=" (cdr (assoc 5 (entget final)))))
    (command "_.MASSPROP" final "" "_N")
  )
)
(command "_.ZOOM" "_E")
(princ)

public_events.text: The first isolated build succeeded as one native solid with the correct 43 × 64 × 22.1 mm bounds. Its native topology also confirmed that the booleans produced real cylindrical and planar faces. I found two half-millimeter longitudinal offsets in the crowded chain dimensions, so I’m rebuilding the intermediate with the through window at 35.5–46.5 mm and the cross holes at 25.5/29.5 mm before visual inspection.

(setvar "INSUNITS" 4)

  (setq e (entlast) parts (cons e parts)) e)
(defun addcutbox (x1 y1 z1 x2 y2 z2 / e)
  (command "_.BOX" (list x1 y1 z1) (list x2 y2 z1) (- z2 z1))
  (setq e (entlast) cuts (cons e cuts)) e)
(defun addcutcyl (p1 p2 r / e)
  (command "_.CYLINDER" p1 r "_A" p2)
  (setq e (entlast) cuts (cons e cuts)) e)
(defun mkss (lst / s)
  (setq s (ssadd))
  (foreach e lst (if (entget e) (ssadd e s)))
  s)
;; Rail profile: 23 wide, 3-wide upper channel, 11.5-wide lower relief.

(addbox -10.75 0.0 0.0 -5.75 64.0 6.1)
(addbox 5.75 0.0 0.0 12.25 64.0 6.1)
;; Mounting ears: 10 long, 7 thick, their upper face 1 below rail crest.
(addbox -20.75 0.0 14.1 -10.65 10.0 21.1)
(addbox 12.15 0.0 14.1 22.25 10.0 21.1)
(addbox -20.75 45.0 14.1 -10.65 55.0 21.1)
(addbox 12.15 45.0 14.1 22.25 55.0 21.1)
(command "_.UNION" (mkss parts) "")
(setq body (ssname (ssget "_X" '((0 . "3DSOLID"))) 0))
;; Full-depth window and the 5 mm right-rail interruption.
(addcutbox -3.0 35.5 -0.5 3.0 46.5 22.6)
(addcutbox 1.49 30.0 15.1 12.30 35.0 22.6)
;; Four mounting bores dia 5.50.
(foreach x '(-15.75 17.25)
  (foreach y '(5.0 50.0)
    (addcutcyl (list x y 13.5) (list x y 22.6) 2.75)))
;; Four blind broad-face M3 pilot bores.
(foreach x '(-8.5 9.0)
  (foreach y '(5.0 55.0)
    (addcutcyl (list x y 22.6) (list x y 14.1) 1.25)))
;; Four end-face M3 pilot bores on a 16 x 7.5 superimposed end pattern:
;; lower-Z pair enters from Y=0, upper-Z pair enters from Y=64.
(foreach x '(-7.25 8.75)
  (progn
    (addcutcyl (list x -0.1 9.0) (list x 8.05 9.0) 1.25)
    (addcutcyl (list x 64.1 16.5) (list x 55.95 16.5) 1.25)))
;; Cross-rail H7 and opposed M4 pilot bores at exact 4 mm pitch.
(addcutcyl (list -10.90 29.5 17.0) (list 12.40 29.5 17.0) 1.5)
(addcutcyl (list -10.90 25.5 17.0) (list -1.40 25.5 17.0) 1.65)
(addcutcyl (list 12.40 25.5 17.0) (list 2.90 25.5 17.0) 1.65)
(command "_.SUBTRACT" body "" (mkss cuts) "")
(setq finalss (ssget "_X" '((0 . "3DSOLID"))))
(princ (strcat "\nFINAL_3DSOLID_COUNT=" (itoa (if finalss (sslength finalss) 0))))
(if finalss
  (progn
    (setq final (ssname finalss 0))
    (princ (strcat "\nFINAL_HANDLE=" (cdr (assoc 5 (entget final)))))
    (command "_.MASSPROP" final "" "_N")))
(command "_.ZOOM" "_E")
(princ)

public_events.text: The rendered intermediate now matches the drawing’s topology: two long stepped rails, a narrow longitudinal channel, the asymmetric 5 mm break in the right rail, the central through window, the underside relief, and four outboard mounting ears. The blind and transverse bores also appear on the intended faces. I’m running the final native audit and then a fresh topology export on the submission file.

arguments.lisp:
(setvar "CMDECHO" 0)
(setvar "FILEDIA" 0)
(setvar "INSUNITS" 4)
(command "_.UCS" "_W")
(setq all (ssget "_X"))
(setq solids (ssget "_X" '((0 . "3DSOLID"))))
(princ (strcat "\nMODEL_ENTITY_COUNT=" (itoa (if all (sslength all) 0))))
(princ (strcat "\nMODEL_3DSOLID_COUNT=" (itoa (if solids (sslength solids) 0))))
(if (and all solids (= (sslength all) 1) (= (sslength solids) 1))
  (progn
    (setq final (ssname solids 0))
    (princ (strcat "\nFINAL_HANDLE=" (cdr (assoc 5 (entget final)))))
    (command "_.MASSPROP" final "" "_N")
    (command "_.AUDIT" "_Y")
    (setq all2 (ssget "_X"))
    (setq solids2 (ssget "_X" '((0 . "3DSOLID"))))
    (princ (strcat "\nPOST_AUDIT_ENTITY_COUNT=" (itoa (if all2 (sslength all2) 0))))
    (princ (strcat "\nPOST_AUDIT_3DSOLID_COUNT=" (itoa (if solids2 (sslength solids2) 0)))))
  (princ "\nFINAL_VALIDATION_FAILED"))
(command "_.ZOOM" "_E")
(princ)
